ramnog: Documentation Hub for the 'chef' Ecosystem

Source: R/ramnog-package.R
ramnog-package.Rd

ramnog provides vignettes and documentation for the chef ecosystem of R packages for clinical trial evidence generation following AMNOG guidelines. The core functionality is provided by chef, chefStats, and chefCriteria.

Vignettes

Use browseVignettes("ramnog") to see all available vignettes.
